description: Na₂SrV₂CoO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.94 Å. Sr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-3.13 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-41°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.77 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-44°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.71-1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.19 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.14 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, one V, and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Co atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sr, one V, and one Co atom.
